basic_details.job_title: Panjab University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.department: Department of Evening Studies – Multi Disciplinary Research Centre (DES-MDRC)

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Master’s degree in Commerce from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Physically & Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade. Must have cleared UGC-NET in Commerce or similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET, or hold a Ph.D. degree in accordance with UGC Regulations 2009/2016.

qualification.details: Guest Faculty in Commerce: Master’s degree in Commerce from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Physically & Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade. Must have cleared UGC-NET in Commerce or similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET, or hold a Ph.D. degree in accordance with UGC Regulations 2009/2016.

rows.details: Department of Evening Studies – Multi Disciplinary Research Centre (DES-MDRC)
Rs. 1,500/- per lecture (ceiling of Rs. 50,000/- per month)

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: Applications are invited for 01 vacancy of Guest Faculty in the Department of Evening Studies – MDRC for teaching B.Com (FYUP) classes from Monday to Friday between 2.00 PM to 9.00 PM.

rows.qualification: Master’s degree in Commerce from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Physically & Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade. Must have cleared UGC-NET in Commerce or similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET, or hold a Ph.D. degree in accordance with UGC Regulations 2009/2016.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum ceiling of Rs. 50,000/- per month. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The interview date will be intimated later via the candidate's email address provided in the application form.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Panjab University Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: Download the application form (Pages 1 to 12) from the Panjab University website under employment/jobs or via the official web link. Fill out the application form completely as per UGC Regulation 2018 guidelines. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents to the application form. Prepare two (02) complete copies of the application form along with enclosures. Submit the two copies of the complete application form by hand or post in the Office of DES-MDRC latest by 23.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Completed application form (Pages 1 to 12) in two copies Self-attested copies of relevant certificates and educational documents Proof of Master's degree in Commerce UGC-NET / SLET / SET certificate or Ph.D. degree documents (if exempted from NET)

Visit the official Panjab University website

faq.question: Q1. Is the Guest Faculty post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a lecture basis (contractual/temporary) for the academic session 2026-2027 (odd semester) with a token honorarium.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation or mark relaxation?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, Physically Handicapped, and Visually Handicapped categories are eligible for a relaxation in Master's degree marks down to 50% instead of 55%.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents need to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit two complete copies of the application form (pages 1 to 12) along with self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the complete application form in the office of DES-MDRC is 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. How much remuneration will be paid to the selected candidate?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a token honorarium of Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, subject to a monthly ceiling of Rs. 50,000/-.
